note: Both sets contain duplicated and misparsed entities ("n-axis telescope", "axis telescope") and both repeat claims, but Set A additionally captures the LUVOIR-B baseline (8 m off-axis telescope, three science instruments), which Set B omits entirely — a whole mission concept missing. Set A also binds the Lynx 10 m value to focal length correctly, whereas Set B twice calls the Lynx 3 m a telescope diameter rather than the grazing-incidence mirror assembly diameter and includes a vague "spacecraft | science instrument count | 4" claim whose quote does not bind to HabEx. Set B does capture the HabEx and Origins instrument counts that Set A lacks, but the LUVOIR-B omission is the larger gap, so Set A is modestly better.
